T1486.sigma:
title: Ransomware - Encrypting files
logsource:
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4624
  condition: selection
  level: high
suricata: alert tcp any any -> any 445 (msg:"possible ransomware SMB"; sid:2100001;)

T1566.sigma:
title: Phishing email detection
logsource:
  product: email
detection:
  selection:
    subject: "Your account has been suspended"
  condition: selection

T1078.sigma:
title: Valid Accounts - suspicious login
logsource:
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 10
  condition: selection

T1059.sigma:
title: Command and Scripting Interpreter - suspicious commands
logsource:
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    process.name: powershell.exe
  condition: selection
T1059.kibana_query: process.name: powershell.exe AND process.args: (Invoke-Expression OR IEX)
